title: sale_availability_assessment
description: JSON Schema for sale_availability_assessment class in Elephant Lexicon

assessment_identifier.description: Deterministic lowercase SHA-256 identity derived from subject scope, policy version, assessment window, and sorted evidence observation identifiers.

availability_status.description: Policy result for the assessed subject and evidence window.

is_for_sale.description: Boolean projection of availability_status: true for FOR_SALE, false for NOT_FOR_SALE, and null for UNKNOWN or CONFLICT.

list_price_amount_minor.description: Eligible exact, fresh active-listing price in integer minor currency units, or null. Zero is never a sentinel.

list_price_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency paired with list_price_amount_minor, or null.

policy_version.description: Version of the deterministic assessment policy.

assessed_at.description: Timestamp when the assessment was produced.

window_start_at.description: Inclusive start of the evidence window.

window_end_at.description: Inclusive end of the evidence window.

reason_codes.description: One or more stable policy reason codes explaining the assessment.
